aggregation: Read-count weighted transcript predictions at genomic position and strand; reject inconsistent central five-mers. Identical common sites for every method.
m6anet: Released HCT116 RNA002 checkpoint; exact expectation of its 20-read sampling. Ranking uses negative log survival to avoid numerical saturation.
metrics: ROC AUC, trapezoidal precision-recall AUC, and average precision. Three-seed means describe training sensitivity, not confidence intervals.
